title: Participium Futurum Activum
subtitle: Moriturus — 'about to X': radix supini + -urus, -a, -um.
objectives: Formare participium futurum activum ex radice supini (quarta forma principalis)
Vertere participium futurum: 'about to X' / 'going to X'
Cognoscere coniugationem periphrasticam activam (esse + participium futurum)
Recitare tres participia Latina (praesens, perfectum, futurum) simul

content.intro: 'Moritūrī tē salūtant' ('those about to die salute you') — famōsa (quamvīs fortasse nōn historicē authentica) frāsis gladiātōria illūstrat perfectē hoc participium: āctiō FUTŪRA, imminēns.
content.explanation: Participium futūrum āctīvum fōrmātur ā rādīce SUPĪNĪ (invenītur removendō -um ā quārtā fōrmā prīncipālī) + -ūrus, -ūra, -ūrum.

rules.heading: a) Formatio
rules.body: amō, amāre, amāvī, amātum → amāt- + ūrus → amātūrus ('about to love'). mittō, ...missum → missūrus. audiō...audītum → audītūrus. Dēclīnātur ut bonus, -a, -um.

rules.heading: b) Significatio: Intentio vel Imminentia
rules.body: Exprimit āctiōnem futūram, saepe cum sēnsū intentiōnis vel imminentiae: Puer piscātūrus ad flūmen it. ('The boy, about to fish/intending to fish, goes to the river.')

rules.heading: c) Coniugatio Periphrastica Activa
rules.body: Participium futūrum + sum: amātūrus sum ('I am about to love / I am going to love'). Haec cōnstrūctiō, parallēla systēmatī perfectī passīvī, exprimit intentiōnem vel prōximitātem futūrī cum clāritāte quam futūrum simplex nōn semper habet.

rules.heading: d) Conspectus: Tria Participia
rules.body:

Nōtā: Latīna Classica CARET participiō praesentis passīvī ET participiō perfectī āctīvī ('having loved' āctīvē nōn exsistit ut fōrma sōla — vidē īnfīnītīvōs/oratiōnem oblīquam, Gradus IV posteriōrem, prō alternātīvīs).

examples: Morituri te salutant. — Those about to die salute you.
Nautae navigaturi sunt. — The sailors are about to sail.
Puella discessura patrem salutavit. — The girl, about to leave, greeted her father.
Quid facturus es? — What are you going to do?
Roma aeterna mansura est. — Rome is destined to remain eternal.

commonMistakes.wrong: Discipulus tentat formare participium 'perfectum activum' ('having loved', active) ut formam sola.
commonMistakes.right: Latina non habet participium perfectum activum ut forma morphologica sola — solum deponent verba (Gradus IV posterior) habent hanc formam disponibilem.
commonMistakes.why: Systema participiorum Latinum habet 'lacunas' notabiles — non omnis combinatio tempus/vox exsistit pro omni verbo.

commonMistakes.wrong: Radix participii futuri formatur ex radice praesentis, non ex supino.
commonMistakes.right: Radix venit ex supino (quarta forma principalis): missum → missūrus, non *mittūrus.
commonMistakes.why: Radix supini frequenter differt a radice praesentis, praesertim in tertia coniugatione.
